edges.sentence: On 2026-10-02, France 24 reported “The tight race pits Lula, 80, against the son of former far-right president Jair Bolsonaro”; on the same day, Al Jazeera reported “Lula, 80, will face off against Bolsonaro in a first-round vote on Sunday, with polls giving him a slight advantage.”.
On 2026-08-05, The New York Times reported “Brazil’s presidential election approaches”; on 2026-09-08, Al Jazeera reported “October’s presidential election”.
